name: QTT Plan Feature
description: One limit/flag row under a Plan — e.g. max_students=1000, live_classes_enabled=1. No usage_resolver field here: per the hardening review section 2, resolvers are registered in each product's own hooks.py (code, not database data), never editable through this doctype — see qtt_platform/hooks.py's usage_resolvers dict, populated in Phase 6.

fields.label: Feature Key
fields.description: e.g. 'max_students', 'live_classes_enabled'. Scoped implicitly by the parent Plan's own product — no cross-product collision risk.

fields.label: Limit Value
fields.description: Numeric limit as a string, or '0'/'1' for a boolean flag — interpreted by the entitlement engine (Phase 5), never by this doctype itself.
